title: Anomaly art on the map
description: Every anomaly has its own flat SVG silhouette: asteroid field = angular rocks, nebula = soft cloud lobes, supernova = ray star, gravity rift = swirl arcs, entropic scar = jagged crack. Art sits in the outer ring of the hex behind everything, plus a small icon + name badge under the system number (shape first, not colour only). Two anomalies split the hex into halves and show two icons. The app has no light theme yet; the art uses --anomaly-ink so one can be added. Planet name letters are spaced out and their outline thinned. Before shots are the same page with the new art removed and the old letter spacing restored.
